preconditions.description: Attacker must be the admin of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy contract

exploit_hint: As the admin of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy, call upgradeTo() or upgradeToAndCall() to change the implementation contract to a malicious one. This allows you to execute arbitrary code through the proxy, potentially stealing funds or manipulating contract logic. The attack requires admin privileges which may be obtained through social engineering, compromised keys, or improper access control in the admin contract.
